subject: Exclusive Offer Inside: Limited Time Only!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to offer you an exclusive 20% discount on select items for a limited time only. Take advantage of this special offer to upgrade your wardrobe or find the perfect gift for a loved one. Hurry, as this promotion ends soon! Visit our website or stop by our store to explore our collection and enjoy the savings. Thank you for being a loyal customer. Best regards, The Fashion Co. Team
